# SimpleXray Zeptun Android glue

This directory contains the SimpleXray-owned Android/JNI integration for the
Zeptun submodule in `../zeptun`.

The upstream Zeptun source remains unmodified. Project-specific JNI bridge
code, Android build glue, and integration notes belong here so that updating
the submodule does not mix upstream changes with SimpleXray changes.

## Android artifact

The app currently consumes the arm64-v8a static library generated by Zeptun's
Android build:

```sh
ANDROID_NDK_HOME=/path/to/android-ndk ./third_party/zeptun-android/build_android.sh
```

This writes `third_party/zeptun/zig-out/android/prebuilt/arm64-v8a/libzeptun.a`.
The Gradle CMake build links that artifact into `libzeptun-jni.so`; generated
`zig-out` files are intentionally not tracked.
